messages:
ashley: Heads-up — eu2 hosted dashboard just fired sustained alerts: p95 queue latency > 600ms, gpu_pool_utilization=98%, admission_rejections spiked. https://dash.redwood/eu2/pools (graphs noisy).

sre-bot: :rotating_light: Alert eu2-gpu-pool-saturation triggered at 2143658698 — notify: #eng-infra #oncall.

ashley: @pavel any deploys or infra churn in eu2? this looks like capacity but the pattern is odd (many short requests).

pavel: No deploys. Noticed a scheduled job kicked at 02:00 UTC — `ml-backfill-eu2` (batch fanout of small model calls). It’s low QPS per request but very bursty across many sessions. Could be causing many warm cache misses.

carmen: Looking at admission control logs — warmup_wait_count is climbing, and admission is gating until KV cache warms. headroom still reserved but not usable because new sessions are blocked waiting on warmup. That produces queueing without actual GPU saturation in the steady workers.

ashley: Checking pool metrics via admin API: `curl -s https://api.redwood/metrics?pool=eu2 | jq .` sample: 
```
{"gpu_util_pct":98.4, "queue_len":72, "p95_latency_ms":612, "warmup_wait_count":48, "admission_rejections":120}
```

matt: Quick mitigation: increase reserved headroom for eu2 to give admission some breathing room while warm caches ramp. CLI: `rdctl admin set-headroom --region eu2 --pct 20` (was 10%). Caveat: cost bump for hosted.

pavel: Applying headroom override now and relaxing warmup gate threshold temporarily. Running: `rdctl admin set-headroom --region eu2 --pct 20 && rdctl config set adm.warmup_threshold 8s 2s` — will monitor.

ashley: Change applied. Within ~45s p95 dropped to ~220ms, queue_len down to ~18, admission_rejections decreasing. Note: billing telemetry shows ~12% higher GPU-minutes for eu2 in the last 10m.

carmen: Good short-term fix. Long-term we should: 1) separate metrics for warmup-blocked vs capacity-retry so alerts aren’t noisy, 2) tune autoscaler refill window to avoid fragmentation from many small sessions, 3) revisit warmup strategy (prefetch KV for scheduled backfills).

pavel: Agreed. I’ll take the post-incident action: own autoscaler refill window tuning + adding warmup-blocked metric. Will open an infra task and schedule a follow-up retro.

ashley: Filing incident board entry #2143, attaching graphs and CLI commands used. Will update runbook with temporary headroom procedure and guidance on cost tradeoffs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident #2143 created (severity: P2) — assignee: pavel, responders: ashley, carmen, matt.
